evals.prompt: Can you review the SEO of https://your-saas.com ? I want a full audit with scores and prioritized fixes.
evals.expected_output: A complete SEO audit report with score breakdown, findings organized by priority (P0-P3), what's working section, AI search readiness assessment, and quick wins. Should use the 40-check scorecard and produce a numerical score out of 100.

evals.prompt: Check https://stripe.com/docs for SEO issues. Just give me the top problems and a quick score.
evals.expected_output: A focused audit report for a documentation subdomain. Should catch any issues specific to docs pages (thin content, missing schema, heading hierarchy). Should still produce a score even if the user asked for 'quick' — abbreviated but complete.

evals.prompt: I just launched my site at https://example.com — is it ready for Google and ChatGPT to find it? Do an SEO review.
evals.expected_output: An audit report that specifically addresses both traditional SEO (Google) and AI search readiness (ChatGPT/GPTBot). Should check robots.txt for AI crawler rules, llms.txt, structured data quality, and snippet-ready content formatting. Score should reflect both dimensions.
